title: World Bank — Trade and Development Bank (Sudan), ASCENT-Sudan energy and digital access, 2025
description:
"Increased Access to Energy and Digital Services" (component, USD 35,000,000), "Solar-based electricity for Irrigation and Agri-business" (USD 15,000,000), "Solar-based electricity For Public Facilities" (USD 15,000,000), "Program Management, Technical Assistance and Capacity Building" (USD 11,300,000). Original Development Objective: "To expand access to electricity and digital connectivity" (Approved as part of Approval package on 28-May-2025).

Key dates from the World Bank's Implementation Status and Results Report, Seq. 2 (disclosed 13 April 2026): Approval 28-May-2025 (planned and actual), Signing 27-Jun-2025, Effectiveness 25-Oct-2025, Original/Revised Closing 28-Jun-2029. Loan IDA-E4720: Status Effective, Original 76.30, Revised 77.08, Disbursed 0.00, % Disbursed 0%.

Targets by June 2029 include 150,000 people with new or enhanced internet access and 50 telecom towers/connectivity points with improved energy supply; actuals for both were still 0 as of 06-Mar-2026. Implementation is under way: over 30 private-sector expressions of interest received across two rounds, and RFPs launched for solar irrigation (17 Mar 2026) and telecom-sector energy solutions (1 Apr 2026).

title: Global Partnership for Education — UNICEF Sudan Primary Education Emergency Support Project, 2024
description:
"PROPOSED GRANT IN THE AMOUNT OF US$41.9 MILLION FROM THE GLOBAL PARTNERSHIP FOR EDUCATION FUND TO THE UNITED NATIONS CHILDREN'S FUND FOR A SUDAN PRIMARY EDUCATION EMERGENCY SUPPORT PROJECT."

Proposed Development Objective(s): "To support reopened schools in target states and learning continuity in the Republic of the Sudan."

Components: Provision of School Grants — US$14,163,385.00; Facilitating Learning Continuity — US$18,352,300.00; Project Management, Coordination, Technical Assistance, and Monitoring and Evaluation — remainder.

(enriched from World Bank Projects API, id P504621, 2026-09-03): board approval date confirmed 2024-11-19; project status Active; closing date 31-Dec-2026.

title: YahClick (Yahsat) — Canar Telecommunication, Sudan, 2023
description: "YahClick, the Data Solutions subsidiary of Al Yah Satellite Communications Company PJSC (the "Group") has signed a USD 15 million six-year strategic partnership agreement with Canar Telecommunication Co. Ltd of Sudan to further expand its satellite broadband presence in Africa." "Under the agreement, Canar has procured significant satellite capacity from YahClick, which will be used by the company to deliver consistent, reliable and fast broadband internet connectivity to consumers and businesses in Sudan." "Canar is seeking to provide enhanced connectivity to support a series of e-government programs and revitalize the country's banking and private sectors."

title: World Bank / Sudan Transition and Recovery Support MDTF — Sudan Family Support Project, 2020
description:
"IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETION AND RESULTS REPORT (IDA-D7350, IDA-D7700, TF-B4259) ON A GRANT IN THE AMOUNT OF SDR 141 MILLION (US$200 MILLION EQUIVALENT) AND ON A GRANT IN THE AMOUNT OF SDR 147 MILLION (US$210 MILLION EQUIVALENT) AND ON A GRANT IN THE AMOUNT OF US$350 MILLION FROM THE SUDAN TRANSITION AND RECOVERY SUPPORT MULTI-DONOR TRUST FUND TO THE REPUBLIC OF SUDAN FOR THE SUDAN FAMILY SUPPORT PROJECT."

Original Development Objective (approved 08-Oct-2020): "The objective is to deliver cash transfers and improve safety net systems to support the Sudanese families in the Recipient's territory affected by expected economic reforms and other short-term shocks." Current Development Objective (approved 16-Mar-2021, Additional Financing Sequence 02): unchanged.

Key dates: Approval 08-Oct-2020; Signing 23-Oct-2020; Effectiveness 07-Dec-2020; Additional Financing Sequence 02, 16-Mar-2021; Restructuring Sequence 01, 20-Dec-2022; Restructuring Sequence 02, 11-Dec-2023; Operation Closing/Cancellation 30-Jun-2024. Ratings: Outcome Moderately Satisfactory, Bank Performance Satisfactory, M&E Quality Substantial.
